choices.option: Propose a trial period to evaluate their fit.
choices.message: You suggest a trial period at [COST] per day. [event_worker] considers this thoughtfully. 'A trial is reasonable. I'm confident I'll exceed your expectations.' They agree to work at a reduced comfort level ([actual_comfort]) for the first month.

choices.option: Politely decline.
choices.message: You explain that you're not currently hiring. [event_worker] nods understandingly. 'I see. Well, should your needs change, I'll be available. Exceptional workers are always worth considering.' They depart with quiet dignity.
